title: agoseris gracilenta var. greenei
intro: Agoseris gracilenta var. greenei, commonly known as Greene's agoseris or greene's desert marigold, is a rare and endangered variety of the Agoseris gracilenta plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. The health benefits of Agoseris gracilenta var. greenei include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Agoseris gracilenta var. greenei include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its exact mechanisms of action.
